channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Progress 2026: The work continues
item.description: With over 10 years of additional funding on the horizon, Mower’s Opioid Advisory Committee looks back at the first three years and forward for more projects.

item.title: Progress 2026: With a role of the dice, Riverland D&D Club casts a tabletop adventure
item.description: At Riverland Community College, a 25-member Dungeons & Dragons club is rebuilding post-COVID community through inclusive, flexible campaigns on campus and Discord.

item.title: Nature Center invites community to celebrate launch of new Nature Playscape project
item.description: Free family kickoff event is Saturday, March 28, 1–3 p.m.

item.title: Darold Lee Yost
item.description: Darold Lee Yost, 91, longtime resident of LeRoy, Minnesota passed away of natural causes in the early morning hour of March 7, 2026.

item.title: Riverland Community College seeks nominations for Alumni Impact Award
item.description: Riverland Community College launches Alumni Impact Award honoring graduates’ contributions; alumni, employers and community members invited to submit nominations.

item.title: Dayle William Goskesen
item.description: Dayle William Goskesen, 65, of Austin, passed away at his home on Thursday, March 5, 2026. The youngest of six children, Dayle was born on April 21, 1960, to Quentin and Bernice Goskesen in Austin, Minnesota.

item.title: Hayfield's Beaver named All-Conference at Luther
item.description: Hayfield grad Natalie Beaver earns first-team American Rivers all-conference honors for Luther after a season averaging 16.6 points, 10 double-doubles and top-10 finishes in several stats.

item.title: MCHS-Austin announces expansion of its Progressive Care Unit
item.description: Mayo Clinic Health System–Austin will triple its Progressive Care Unit capacity by November, shifting ICU beds to expand intermediate-level care for local patients.

item.title: Austin's Kennedy named Diver of the Meet at Patriot League Championships
item.description: Austin grad Alayna Kennedy earns Diver of the Meet at Patriot League Championships, sweeping 1- and 3-meter titles in a perfect freshman debut for Boston University.

item.title: Area grads are chipping in for Blue Devils on Arizona road trip
item.description: Riverland CC baseball opens Arizona trip 2-3, led by strong starts from Southland grad Austin Swenson and Austin grad Payton Ransom.
